## About
Reseda Transmissions is a locally owned and operated auto repair shop on Vanowen St, serving the San Fernando Valley. Owner Raul Hernandez set out with one goal: to be the most trustworthy and dependable transmission shop in the Valley.
We do diagnostics, rebuilds and maintenance on automatic and manual transmissions, classic cars and newer models, domestic and imported. We also sell transmissions, differentials and transmission parts.
Our technicians ask the right questions, walk you through your options and put together proposals. Then you decide what's best for your situation. No high pressure.

## Services
- Transmission Repair: Expert maintenance, spotting problems and making any needed repairs, whether you drive an automatic or a manual, a classic or the latest model.
- Diagnostics: Finding out what's actually going on before any work is done.
- Trouble Code Scans: Reading the codes your car is throwing so we know where to look.
- ATF & Filter Service: Fluid and filter service to keep your transmission running right.
- Valve Body Service: Service on the valve body that controls how your transmission shifts.
- Rebuilt RWD & FWD Transmissions: Rebuilt transmissions for rear-wheel and front-wheel drive vehicles.
- Final Drive Service: Service on the final drive.

## FAQ
Q: Do rebuilt transmissions come with warranties?
A: Yes. Our rebuilt transmissions come standard with one-year or 12,000 mile warranties, whichever comes first.

Q: Do you offer extended warranties?
A: Yes. We also offer extended two-year or 24,000 mile warranties and three-year or 36,000 mile warranties.

Q: Do you work on imported cars?
A: Yes. We work on domestic and imported vehicles, all major makes and models.

Q: Do you sell transmission parts?
A: We carry valve bodies, solenoid packs, filters, gaskets, torque converters and other transmission parts, new, rebuilt, OEM, used or aftermarket.
